description: Published Lahiri (Chitra paksha) ayanamsa values used to verify ephemeris.ayanamsa().
compared_quantity: true ayanamsa (mean ayanamsa + nutation in longitude); compared with Swiss Ephemeris get_ayanamsa_ex_ut(jd, FLG_SWIEPH), which includes nutation
time_convention: IAE tabulates 'TRUE AYANAMSA FOR 5h 29m'; IAE Indian Calendar timings are I.S.T. (UT+5h30m), so 5h29m IST = 23h59m UT on the previous civil date. Reading it as 5h29m UT instead changes the computed value by < 0.1".
excluded: IAE 2026 lists 2027 Feb. 13 = 24 14 16.4, which breaks the monotonic sequence (Feb. 10 = 24 14 20.9) and is ~4.6" off; treated as a misprint and not used.

values.label: Lahiri definition epoch (Calendar Reform Committee): 1956 March 21, 0h

source.document: Lahiri ayanamsa definition 23 deg 15' 00.658" for 1956 March 21 0h (value given in the Task 4 brief; same constant as Swiss Ephemeris SE_SIDM_LAHIRI). The IAE Indian Calendar explanatory note states the adopted value rounded to 23 deg 15' 00".
source.kind_evidence: Swiss Ephemeris reproduces this value only when nutation is included (true 23.250221 deg vs mean 23.245561 deg), so it is compared as a true ayanamsa.
